mechanism: Furosemide causes hypokalemia and volume depletion which increases sympathomimetic sensitivity; tranylcypromine is an MAOI that potentiates catecholamine effects, creating risk for hypertensive crisis and cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, maintain adequate potassium levels, and consider alternative diuretics; educate patient on dietary sodium/potassium and avoidance of sympathomimetic agents.
